snippet.title: Cats In The Shell | Early Access Launches Jan 20, 2027 | Demo Available Now!
snippet.description:
Cats In The Shell, a mech-building roguelike auto battler from Tencent and NetEase veterans at Raven Studio and publisher Infini Fun, rockets onto PC via Steam Early Access on Wednesday, Jan. 20, 2027. Check out the debut Steam Next Fest demo today ahead of the event.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4688400/_Cats_In_The_Shell/
